structured_output.rationale: The diff makes four changes. It limits the critical-point search to the interval, so `imageset(sin, Interval(-2, 1))` now gives `Interval(-1, sin(1))` (the doctest was updated to show this). It fixes whether endpoints of the image are open or closed. It makes `sin` and `cos` of a `SetExpr` interval evaluate. It leaves an image unevaluated, instead of trying to list the singularities, when there are infinitely many, as with `tan` over the reals. Candidate B covers all of these accurately and gives concrete examples a user can check, though it is wordier than the guide recommends. Candidate A presents the main improvement as if it only affected `SetExpr`, so it misses the plain `imageset` change. Its other two bullets are too vague to tell users what behavior changed.
